Concentration: check the 10-K or 10-Q for customers above 10% of sales and look at those customers' own recent capex commentary.
Penguin's own IR page and 8-Ks since July for any order, backlog or partnership announcements (SK Telecom stake, Penguin Edge/ClusterWare deals), plus Form 4s around the August-September run.
